title: Design System: Soon Jan Jan CV

headline.purpose: "Table N." section titles, number set bold.

title.purpose: The one-sentence line under the name.

body.purpose: Table cells and running text; labels use the italic.

margin-head.purpose: Uppercase margin heading for the Abstract only.

print-root.purpose: Root size on paper; rem steps scale from it.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: All state transitions and the hero rule draw.

motion.name: rule-draw
motion.purpose: Table 1's heavy rules draw in on arrival.

motion.name: row-in
motion.purpose: Table 1 rows settle in; filtered Table 4 rows re-enter (0.45s).

motion.name: figure-1
motion.purpose: Axes, points, OLS line, residuals; plays once in view; final frame under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: One per region: the main action (Write to me, Open in my email app).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: "CMU Serif", "Latin Modern Roman", Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.02rem; min-height: 46px; padding: 0 22px; background: #1e4a3d; color: #f4f5f2; border: 0.75px solid #1e4a3d; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), color .2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #15181e; border-color: #15181e; color: #f4f5f2; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d4ed8; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { font-family: "CMU Serif", "Latin Modern Roman", Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.02rem; min-height: 46px; padding: 0 22px; background: transparent; color: #15181e; border: 0.75px solid #15181e; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #e9ebe6; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d4ed8; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Ruled field: stripe-paper ground, ink bottom rule, italic label above.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; font-family: "CMU Serif", "Latin Modern Roman", Georgia, serif; } .ds-field span { font-style: italic; color: #474d5a; } .ds-field input { font: inherit; font-size: 1.125rem; min-height: 46px; padding: 12px; background: #e9ebe6; color: #15181e; border: 0; border-bottom: 0.75px solid #15181e; border-radius: 0; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border-bottom: 2px solid #1d4ed8; background: #dfe7fb; }

components.name: Running Head
components.description: Sticky series-green band; current section carries the solid rule.
components.html: Soon Jan Jan Curriculum vitaeAbstractTeachingPublications
components.css: .ds-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 22px; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 24px; background: #1e4a3d; color: #f4f5f2; font-family: "CMU Serif", "Latin Modern Roman", Georgia, serif; } .ds-head b { margin-right: auto; } .ds-head i { font-weight: 400; opacity: .8; } .ds-head a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; opacity: .78; padding: 14px 0; border-bottom: 1.5px solid transparent; } .ds-head a:hover { opacity: 1; border-bottom: 0.75px dashed currentColor; } .ds-head a[aria-current="true"] { opacity: 1; border-bottom: 1.5px solid currentColor; }

components.name: Booktabs Table
components.description: The signature: heavy top, light mid, heavy bottom; italic heads; hairline rows.
components.css: .ds-bt { border-top: 1.5px solid #15181e; border-bottom: 1.5px solid #15181e; font-family: "CMU Serif", "Latin Modern Roman", Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-variant-numeric: lining-nums tabular-nums; color: #15181e; } .ds-bt table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; } .ds-bt th, .ds-bt td { text-align: left; padding: .62em 1.25em .62em 0; } .ds-bt th { font-weight: 400; font-style: italic; color: #474d5a; border-bottom: 0.75px solid #15181e; } .ds-bt tbody tr + tr td { border-top: 0.75px solid #c8ccd2; } .ds-bt tbody tr:hover { background: #e9ebe6; }

components.name: Open Entry
components.description: A proof mark for a detail the author has yet to supply.
components.css: .ds-p { font-family: "CMU Serif", "Latin Modern Roman", Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.125rem; color: #15181e; } .ds-tbd { color: #1d4ed8; font-style: italic; background: #dfe7fb; border-bottom: 1px dashed #1d4ed8; padding: 0 .15em; border-radius: 1px; }

components.name: Column Specification
components.description: Numbered-column filter; the chosen column takes the solid rule.
components.css: .ds-spec { display: flex; gap: 28px; font-family: "CMU Serif", "Latin Modern Roman", Georgia, serif; } .ds-spec button { font: inherit; font-size: 1.125rem; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 2px; background: none; border: 0; border-bottom: 0.75px dashed #737a87; color: #474d5a; cursor: pointer; } .ds-spec button:hover { color: #15181e; border-bottom-color: #15181e; } .ds-spec button[aria-pressed="true"] { color: #15181e; border-bottom: 1.5px solid #15181e; } .ds-spec button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d4ed8; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
The page is set the way an economist's paper sets its evidence: Computer Modern on offset paper, booktabs rules, numbered tables and figures, and notes under each table. Academic peers read that grammar every day, so they recognise the page's discipline before they read a word. The CV is a record, and the system presents it as one, with no marketing chrome.

The tone is exact, quiet and honest. Hierarchy comes from the typography of a well-set journal page: a large bold name, captions such as "Table 2." in bold, and italic column heads and labels. Colour is used sparingly and always for a job. The series green marks the working-paper band, and the proofreader's blue marks every link and every entry still waiting for the author. Missing facts are never hidden or invented. They appear as proof marks, which is also the system's most distinctive device.

There is one authored moment of motion. On arrival, Figure 1's least-squares line draws itself through illustrative data while Table 1's rules draw in beside it. Everything else stays still.
keyCharacteristics: One typeface, Computer Modern Serif (CMU), self-hosted, with tabular lining figures.
Booktabs tables: a heavy top rule, a light rule under the head, a heavy bottom rule, and hairline row dividers.
Numbered apparatus: Table 1–5, Figure 1, "Notes:" lines and lettered footnotes.
A series-green band for the running head and footer; proofreader's blue for links and open entries.
A flat page with no shadows, no cards, and corners of 2px or less.
Light and dark themes from the same tokens; the page prints as the CV.

rules.name: The Proof-Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue means "act here" or "still to be written". Use it for links, focus and open entries, never for decoration or emphasis.

rules.name: The Series Band Rule
rules.body: Series green appears only on the running head, the footer band, the primary action and the fitted line. A second accent colour is never added.

rules.name: The Ink-3 Rule
rules.body: Ink 3 is for marks, not words. Text never drops below Ink 2.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Every element uses Computer Modern Serif. Hierarchy comes from size, weight and italic. Never add a sans, a mono or a second serif.

rules.name: The Apparatus Rule
rules.body: Tables and figures are numbered in reading order and captioned with a bold number. Explanations go below as "Notes:" or lettered footnotes, never in tooltips or cards.

rules.name: The Booktabs Rule
rules.body: Tables get exactly three structural rules: a heavy top, a light rule under the head, and a heavy bottom. Rows are separated by hairlines. Never use vertical rules, boxed cells or zebra striping at rest.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the page casts a shadow, and nothing floats above the paper.

rules.name: The Solid-Means-Chosen Rule
rules.body: An active filter column or current nav section gets a solid 1.5px rule beneath it. Inactive and hovered states use a dashed 0.75px rule.

dos: Do set every new record as a numbered booktabs table with a bold "Table N." title and notes underneath.
Do mark every unknown fact as an open entry (.tbd) until the author supplies it.
Do label any demonstration data "Illustrative data" in the caption.
Do keep figures tabular and lining, and align text to the rules' left edge.
Do keep the one authored motion moment, and keep everything else still.
Do check new text against Ink 2 or stronger in both themes, and print-preview new sections.
donts: Don't use cards, shadows, rounded containers, or corners over 2px.
Don't add stat counters, percentage skill bars, progress rings or big-number "metrics". They are claims the record does not make.
Don't put a kicker or eyebrow label above a heading.
Don't use significance stars, standard errors or coefficients on anything that is not an estimate.
Don't add a second accent colour, a gradient, a sans-serif or a monospace face.
Don't use emoji or Unicode glyphs as icons; draw them as SVG in the 1.6-stroke family.
Don't invent publications, dates, titles or links to fill a table.
